definitions.explanation: The state of being similar or resembling something else. A formal word often used in written, academic, or legal contexts.

examples.japanese: {類似|るいじ}{品|ひん}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful of imitation products.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}には{類似|るいじ}{点|てん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The two cases have many similarities.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}のデザインは{有名|ゆうめい}ブランドの{製品|せいひん}に{類似|るいじ}しているとして{訴|うった}えられた。
examples.english: This product was sued for having a design that resembles that of a famous brand.

notes:
A formal, written-style word. In everyday conversation, {似|に}ている or {似|に}たような are more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類似|るいじ}{品|ひん} (imitation product, knockoff)
- {類似|るいじ}{点|てん} (point of similarity)
- {類似|るいじ}{性|せい} (similarity — as a measurable property)
- ～に{類似|るいじ}する (to resemble ~)
- {類似|るいじ}した{事例|じれい} (similar cases)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {類似|るいじ} is formal and analytical
- {似|に}ている is the everyday equivalent
- {酷似|こくじ} means striking resemblance (stronger)
